plotEn:
All About Corinne (French: Ni vue, ni connue, lit. "Neither Seen Nor Known") is a French comedy film, directed by Marc Fitoussi and released in 2026. The film stars Isabelle Huppert as Corinne Maclou, a background actress who aspires to break through to starring roles, and befriends actress Sandrine Kiberlain in the hopes of achieving her dream.
